sourceFindings.finding: Exact owned push repository, actor, workflow, ref, attempt1, source commit/tree, single fixed Ops parent, exact nine changed paths, clean trees and builder SHA are checked before key access.

Only Claude is executable. One private derivative template and one fresh Sandbox.create with a 120-second instance TTL; no model, CLI execution, application worker or Smoke. Absolute observation interval is at most 900 seconds (17:07:29–17:22:29 UTC), work cap600 seconds and independent cleanup cap150 seconds. The workflow ceiling20 minutes explicitly permits cleanup after the observation deadline.

Four named phases each contain exactly the three fixed CA nodes. Each node records full lstat type/mode/UID/GID/device/inode/size/timestamps plus file SHA256 or raw symlink target. Only the two fixed symlink targets and a regular-file terminal root are allowed. Guest reads files with O_NOFOLLOW and identity checks, resolves fixed references, then rechecks the same three nodes. Host recomputes chains; absent/too-large/changed/extra/duplicate nodes cannot be observed-success. No file bytes are serialized.

The source performs before and pre_finalization during derivative build, ready via its start command and fresh in the one created instance. Final evidence must use actual returned phase/boot/time records; this review does not infer unseen timestamps or causal process identity from phase names.

Returned template/build IDs are captured, private nondefault exact alias/name binding checked, and fresh instance identity is checked against exact template/metadata. Cleanup terminates clients first, verifies exact sandbox scope, kills and confirms absence by ID. Builder cleanup prefers known templateID, validates private/name/alias/nondefault ownership, deletes exact ID and checks GET404. Unreturned create/build IDs remain unresolved; alias404 alone is not absence for a known ID. Public/foreign templates are retained/rejected.

The fixed file contains32 offline tests covering shape, no private content, races, ownership, lost IDs and cleanup. This reviewer did not run tests or read the job stdout; metadata reports the existing offline guard step success.

requiredOwnerEvidence.note: The owner Git originals have not yet been posted at this finite follow-up read. Metadata success is not substituted for raw stat/cleanup receipts.

interpretationLimits.attribution: The reviewed control source contains only a bounded metadata observer and no Mikka installation. If its actual observations show the transition, they support an independent provider boot/finalization mechanism inference, not an observed writer-process identity or same-build R7 experiment.
